name: market-day
description: Marketday, a cinematic village of autonomous NEAR agents.

scripts.video:preview: cd marketday-videos && node scripts/build-video-props.mjs && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.7 preview
scripts.video:lint: cd marketday-videos && node scripts/build-video-props.mjs && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.7 lint
scripts.video:render:day-intro: cd marketday-videos && npx tsx scripts/build-audio.ts && node scripts/build-video-props.mjs && mkdir -p out && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.7 render -o out/day-intro-silent.mp4 && node scripts/mux-audio.mjs out/day-intro-silent.mp4 assets/audio/marketday-final-audio.wav out/day-intro.mp4
scripts.video:render:lower-third: cd marketday-videos && node scripts/build-video-props.mjs && mkdir -p out && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.7 render --composition compositions/lower-third.html -o out/lower-third.mp4
scripts.video:render:stat-card: cd marketday-videos && node scripts/build-video-props.mjs && mkdir -p out && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.7 render --composition compositions/stat-card.html -o out/stat-card.mp4
scripts.video:render:blocked-moment: cd marketday-videos && node scripts/build-video-props.mjs && mkdir -p out && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.7 render --composition compositions/blocked-moment.html -o out/blocked-moment.mp4
scripts.video:render:final-outro: cd marketday-videos && node scripts/build-video-props.mjs && mkdir -p out && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.7 render --composition compositions/final-outro.html -o out/final-outro.mp4
